facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A tear fell. A fairy appeared. She made him real. Love made him real.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The rabbit's tear fell to the ground and a flower grew. A beautiful fairy appeared from inside the flower. She was the fairy who makes loved toys become real. Love made him real because the boy's love was true. The fairy kissed the rabbit and light surrounded him. Something wonderful was happening to the velveteen rabbit.
facts.Word cards: love = 사랑 / made = 만들었다 / magic = 마법 / miracle = 기적
